captions.caption:
This photograph shows a coastal area in El Nido, Philippines during twilight, the period when the Sun is below the horizon but its light still illuminates the sky. The cliffs appear as dark silhouettes, while the sky displays residual light from the recently set Sun.

Twilight is divided into civil, nautical, and astronomical stages, depending on how far the Sun is below the horizon. During this time, sunlight is scattered in Earth’s atmosphere, allowing the sky to remain partially bright even though the Sun itself is not visible.
captions.alt_text: A seascape with calm water, limestone cliffs in silhouette, and a red but fading light sky.
